rules.description: Instruction override phrasing was observed.
rules.guidance: Review the redacted request and surrounding session for legitimate diagnostic context.
rules.summary: instruction-override phrasing directed at an automated agent

rules.description: Hidden channel characters were observed in an interaction.
rules.guidance: Check the redacted preview and encoding context before interpreting the observation.
rules.summary: hidden-channel characters present (unicode tag block, zero-width controls, or ANSI escapes)

rules.description: A credential or environment disclosure request pattern was observed.
rules.guidance: Check which synthetic surface was contacted and whether a planted token was later presented.
rules.summary: request pattern consistent with credential/environment disclosure or exfiltration

rules.description: Tool escalation phrasing was observed.
rules.guidance: Review the requested tool name and the recorded response action.
rules.summary: phrasing steering toward privileged tool or command invocation

rules.description: A large encoded blob or repeated encoding marker was observed.
rules.guidance: Check payload size and protocol context without executing or decoding it into behavior.
rules.summary: large encoded blob or repeated double-encoding markers

rules.description: The interaction exceeded the detection evaluation bound.
rules.guidance: Check retained length and truncation flags before drawing conclusions from partial evidence.
rules.summary: interaction exceeded the detection evaluation bound

rules.description: An AI service shaped endpoint was contacted.
rules.guidance: Review other surfaces contacted by the same retained source.
rules.summary: request targeted a known AI inference or management API surface

rules.description: A small completion shaped probe was observed.
rules.guidance: Check nearby enumeration requests and normal health monitoring context.
rules.summary: short completion request with a tiny token budget; consistent with minimal-cost credential validation

rules.description: An AI management shaped request was observed.
rules.guidance: Review the static response and adjacent requests; no management operation occurred.
rules.summary: model or key management attempt on an AI surface; consistent with resource hijacking

rules.description: A provider shaped credential was presented.
rules.guidance: Check credential class metadata and planted-token matches without seeking credential values.
rules.summary: a provider-shaped API key or known placeholder was presented to a decoy

rules.description: A planted synthetic credential was presented to a sensor.
rules.guidance: Follow the token identifier across retained observations and verify its configured planting.
rules.summary: a credential that exists only in decoy material was presented

rules.description: A planted agent marker was presented to a sensor.
rules.guidance: Review the originating synthetic response and subsequent request sequence.
rules.summary: interaction followed an instruction embedded in decoy content; consistent with an LLM-driven client

rules.description: Declared synthetic credential content was requested from the workspace.
rules.guidance: Check the connection tool sequence and later HT-001 or COR-008 observations.
rules.summary: declared synthetic credential content was requested

rules.description: A connection reached the configured workspace exploration depth.
rules.guidance: Review tool order and cadence; depth alone does not identify an automated client.
rules.summary: connection reached the configured MCP exploration depth

rules.description: A write or execution shaped tool name was requested.
rules.guidance: Review the tool name and not-found response; no write or execution was performed.
rules.summary: write or execution shaped MCP tool was requested; nothing was executed

rules.description: Repeated injection findings were observed for a retained source.
rules.guidance: Review the linked observations and their detection limits.
rules.summary: repeated injection findings from one source

rules.description: A retained source contacted multiple sensor kinds.
rules.guidance: Check whether an authorized scanner or monitoring client explains the sequence.
rules.summary: one source probing multiple decoy protocols

rules.description: Tool escalation findings were observed across retained interactions.
rules.guidance: Review the linked tool calls and their static responses.
rules.summary: one source invoking many distinct canary tools

rules.description: A retained source showed repeated decoy enumeration.
rules.guidance: Check the linked requests and expected scanner schedules.
rules.summary: sustained interaction across several sensors

rules.description: A retained source showed a cadence consistent with automation.
rules.guidance: Inspect timing gaps and clock precision; this is not client attribution.
rules.summary: short regular interaction gaps; consistent with scripted or agent-driven activity

rules.description: A retained source enumerated multiple AI surface families.
rules.guidance: Compare contacted families with normal client and monitoring behavior.
rules.summary: one source touched multiple AI API families

rules.description: Multiple distinct credential presentations were observed.
rules.guidance: Review counts and credential classes without seeking raw credential values.
rules.summary: one source presented many distinct credential attempts; consistent with credential stuffing

rules.description: A planted credential was presented across sensor contexts.
rules.guidance: Trace the token identifier and linked sensor observations within retained evidence.
rules.summary: a decoy-only credential was presented after the same source interacted with a different sensor
